title: The Bridge of Two Wagging Tails
synopsis: The Little Bridge opens. Rex finally meets Molly at Green Gate Farm, and Jack draws the new connection.
continuity_state: Before: Bridge fully built but not open to visitors. After: Little Bridge opens for pedestrians and animals, not vehicles. Pine Park gains a short branch to the bridge; Green Gate Farm becomes walkable from Brook Road. Rex and Molly meet and become friends; Jack sketches the new route.
